subject: Re: Kickoff: principal-subspace aux tasks for retrieval
body:
Status ahead of the big sweep week.

Reproduction is done: synthetic-matrix runs (S=50, T=50, d=10, lissa) match the released results, and the MNIST variant (d=16) converges as expected. Scaled estimator now runs on a 10% slice of the retrieval embedding matrix; top-64 subspace features added as aux targets give +1.7% recall@10 on the internal eval suite vs. the PCA baseline.

One technical risk for the sweep: LISSA's covariance estimates get noisy at our batch sizes when the spectrum has a long flat tail, which our embedding matrices do. Mitigation is bigger covariance batches (covariance_batch_size up 4x), which is exactly why the sweep needs the full 256-accelerator week rather than trickling on best-effort. If the reservation moves, the launch review moves with it - want that dependency explicit.

Wei
